text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Faster... I need to be faster...
I'll never
beat
Suzuka at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm beginning to sense a dangerous aura
about
Air Groove during our recent
training sessions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling her determination to
surpass
Silence Suzuka is pushing her to
risky extremes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, it occurs to me that I haven't
been to a
shrine yet this year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove chewed me out last year
about not having any holiday spirit.
She'll definitely bite if I
mention this to
her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What are you staring at? Do you have
something
to say about my running?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
choice_data_list: Actually, I haven't gone for Hatsu...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No... It can't be... How could I let this
happen?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove is way more flustered than I imagined!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I knew these things meant a lot to her, but can she really be this horrified on my behalf?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: HOW HAVE I NOT GONE YET?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll never forgive myself! I was so caught
up in
training that I almost let this
celebration pass me
by!
choice_data_list: Wait, Air Groove too?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Why are you just standing there?! We're leaving right this second!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined Air Groove would have 
forgotten, but it was a happy
miscalculation. This should present a
good chance for her to relax. We get
ready and head out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove and I finish giving our
respects at a
local shrine.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This doesn't happen often, but I must
thank you.
If weren't for your reminder, I
would've
completely forgotten about it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... This is clear proof of negligence
on my
part!
choice_data_list: You're welcome.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I need to up my game! Otherwise, I'm
never going
to beat Suzuka...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Let's hurry back. Time is precious,
and I
need to spend it training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I start to panic.
I need to nip this in the bud
before things get out of hand. But
how am I going to get her to take the
whole day off?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I start to panic.
I need to nip this in the bud
before things get out of hand. But
how am I going to get her to take the
whole day off?

text_block_list.text:
Did you even listen to what I just said?
We
haven't a moment to lose!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

Aren't you doing anything New Year...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I suppose a shrine visit alone isn't
enough to
constitute a proper New
Year's celebration...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you're using my own
words against
me...
choice_data_list: Gotta keep the seasonal feel.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fine, I surrender. My lifestyle may
indeed have
been lacking in balance of
late.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Let's eat something seasonal before we
head
back. Any ideas?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Is that the only New Year's food you
know?
choice_data_list: ...Like ozoni soup?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove and I get some mochi soup
before
heading back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems to have loosened up a bit. I
think the
time off did her some good.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I want to get stronger?" As always, your
phrasing
needs some work. Besides, I
don't have time to
waste on—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ngh.

Don't you usually write an ema?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Actually, I usually do.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Writing out my goals is an effective way
to
heighten my awareness of them.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I suppose you're right. But let's make
this quick.

Then let's write it down!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to retract my earlier
statement. I
may have
been more... on edge lately
than I realized.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's get to it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So tell me. What are you going to write?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You moron... Could you have phrased
that any
more poorly?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove and I discuss how to best
write our
wishes on the wooden prayer
tablets.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we chat, I notice her expression
growing less
strained. I let out a sigh of
relief.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Did you even listen to a word I said? I
told you
time is of the essence.

text_block_list.text: I don't... entirely disagree.

text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I hate that you're using my own
words
against me.

text_block_list.text: Fine.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll placate you just this once. What are
you
standing around for? Come on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove's fortune reads, "You are
rushing
forward with little regard for
your health. Find
time to relax."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove takes the words to heart,
resolving to focus on the training she
really needs to do rather
than recklessly
racking up session after session.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This shift in focus helps to relieve the
excessive pressure she had been feeling,
leading her back
to the path of
efficiency.
